description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding {C}{C}.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Unicorn, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, causing it to return to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Repeat.

uses.name: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader
